title: Product of a parity tree assignment
statement: Let $n,r,t,g$ be natural numbers and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The product of the $r$ signs assigned by the parity tree at level $t$ to the indices $gr,gr+1,\ldots,gr+r-1$ equals the parity tree value at level $t+1$ and index $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
